additional_info.subject: AW: ID0372204-DC/SID/DE-[MP / R3 170001600]-Cable Management System Defect CRM:01282000428
additional_info.body:
Hi Vaishnavy,
Please note that we are not using chargers with Huber+Suhner cables/connectors.
All of our chargers are equipped with Phoenix Contact supplies.
We as a customer have no tape to reapply the cable clamp, as well as we are not aware of the exact tape specification of Siemens for this use case. Therefore, we will not reapply any cable clamp due to warranty issues and product liability regarding Siemens.
Please assign a field technician for this case.
Kind regards,
Marius Schneider
